item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Walmart grounds crew helps save 2 women after car crashes into North Port creek: NPFR
item.description: Take a look at the grass lawn on the side of the Walmart parking lot on Tamiami Trail in North Port, and it seems normal, but take a step closer, and you will see a broken tail light, a damaged fence and cut down trees.
